question: The Indian festival of Holi comes every year in the season of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**spring**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Indian festival of Holi is celebrated every year in the season of **spring**.
 
• Holi, also known as the "Festival of Colors," marks the arrival of spring and the end of winter.
